title: Claude root sessions have no credited launch shape for the full gate: a foreground one-call `pushd "DIR" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full` exceeds the Bash tool's 10-minute cap, a background or --detach launch carries no result, and the launcher's terminal result is not credited to the creating session
outcome: A one-call check in the documented form `pushd "C:\…\.tmp\wt-standin" && cargo test …` gets no credit: "ran after another command on its line, which TermAl cannot place"
acceptance: A one-call check in the documented form `pushd "C:\…\.tmp\wt-standin" && cargo test …` gets no credit: "ran after another command on its line, which TermAl cannot place" is done
